snippet.title: The Labyrinth is Open | Play Now on Steam | Minos Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the legendary minotaur and build the trap-filled labyrinth of your dreams – and their nightmares – in mythical roguelike Minos, out now.

Minos is a maze-building roguelite where you, the fabled Minotaur, must defend your sanctuary from bloodthirsty adventurers. Design and re-design deadly labyrinths, set traps, and turn every brave fool into your next victim.

Available now on Steam.

#minos #mazebuilding #maze #towerdefense #roguelike #roguelite
